# Native-action sentence sample

Selected English sentences and entity names from [OHF-Voice/intents](https://github.com/OHF-Voice/intents/tree/d7bab6f383ec338d70df985747d23f43946d4dc9), revision `d7bab6f383ec338d70df985747d23f43946d4dc9`, by the Open Home Foundation and contributing authors. Licensed under [CC BY 4.0](LICENSE.md). `cases.json` records each source path.

The sample retains at most two sentences per named media/vacuum intent. Original YAML fixtures were condensed to JSON, and Phoenix-specific service, permission and refusal expectations are supplied by the test module. These fixtures do not assert that every upstream sentence or slot combination is supported by Phoenix or the installed Home Assistant release.
